column1: # Safety audit of a Claude-only draft: a QA record, not the council's back-translation.

column3: Drops proximity: the tile says only PIN, so a rider cannot tell it also holds proximity unlock. Fix: PIN e proximidade (wraps at a space, each line fits 90dp).

Drops schedule: with its value (e.g. On • 7:30 AM) Carregamento can read as charging being on, not a timed start, and it matches the plain Charging label. Fix: Carregamento programado (glossary term; wraps at a space, each word fits 90dp).
